summary_for_children: Az-Zumar means The Groups. It calls us to worship Allah sincerely, reminds us of His mercy and that we should never despair of it, and speaks of people going in groups to their final place.
environment_concept: Rain running underground into springs (39:21), crops that grow, turn yellow and dry (39:21) and a soft light on the horizon (39:73; nothing of Paradise is pictured).
architecture_and_scenery: Rainy valley, springs running through rock, crops turning yellow, and a horizon with abstract gates of light.

palette.lighting: Rain light then soft golden haze

areas.name: Fading Crops
areas.description: Crops that grow, turn yellow and dry: life is short.

areas.name: Gates of Light
areas.description: Abstract gates of light on the horizon; symbolic only, not a picture of Paradise.

activities.name: Water cycle
activities.description: Carry rain clouds over the fields.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Never despair
activities.description: Light a lantern of hope by reading 39:53.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: Narration stresses mercy and hope; the unseen is spoken of only through ayahs.

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (grain, horizon, spring) with 1 hands-on activity in the scene
status.testing: not tested yet: written and type-checked, not yet checked on screen

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.tier: conceptual for the new engine (an older composed scene exists; not validated as unique)
